text:
lee: Noticed odd behavior hitting the JS onboarding sample under steady load: client-side concurrency drops then all streaming requests hang. Repro on staging.

anna: Any logs or steps?

lee: Steps: set sdk.concurrency=20, prefetch=8, run `wrk -c40 -t2 -d60s` against /chat/stream. After ~15s active streams fall to 2 and requests queue.

rafa: Do we see 429s or timeouts from the server?

lee: No 429, just client-side backpressure. Logs: ```
INFO queue: inflight=2 queued=78 permits=0
WARN backpressure: dropped_lease_waits=34 retry_path=token_refresh
```

sre-miguel: That "token_refresh" path in the log rings a bell. We had a parity bug where Python SDK releases leases on refresh but JS didn't.

anna: Is this new after the auth retry change last week?

lee: Yes, started after the new exponential-refresh patch. Python sample unaffected.

rafa: Quick triage: add a guard that releases the permit on any auth error before retrying. Also instrument a counter `lease_release_failures`.

anna: Can someone try a hotfix in sampleapp (JS) before we ship a full SDK fix? A config toggle to disable prefetch might be useful for customers while we root cause.

lee: I'll open a tiny PR with try/finally around `acquireLease()` + a `sampleapp.config.prefetch=false` toggle.

devex-bot: Issue created: #4992-js-lease-release-on-auth-fix (link)

rafa: After the fix, we should run a parity test between JS and Python that simulates a 401 during streaming and asserts no lease leaks.

lee: I'll add a mocha test for JS and a small harness that injects a 401 mid-stream.

anna: Also add a short note in devex onboarding doc: if customers see client queue growth during streaming, flip `prefetch` off and upgrade SDK.

sre-miguel: For a Canary, set sdk.concurrency=10, prefetch=3 and monitor `permits_held` metric. If it spikes >5% for 2m we abort.

rafa: Sounds good. I'll own the telemetry dash and alert.

lee: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sampleapp/pull/2011 (WIP). Will link test results here when ready.

anna: Thanks team. Quick and surgical WIP appreciated :thumbsup:
